verdicts.reason: A: the headline is far too large and wraps, leaving 'fizz' alone on its own line and crowding out everything else. The legal text is tiny, squeezed in beside the CTA and wrapped so 'details.' sits alone, and the logo and can are jammed against the left edge on top of the circle.
